name: OVOForm – create any form without touching code
author: ovosolution

sections.description:
Build the forms your site needs – from a simple contact form to a complex survey – by clicking a few buttons, with no coding skills required.

Why OVOForm?

OVOForm is a powerful and intuitive form builder plugin for WordPress, designed to simplify the process of creating and managing forms on your website. Whether you need a simple contact form or a complex survey, you assemble it visually in the dashboard and place it anywhere with a shortcode.

Every form is fully responsive, submissions are stored so you can review them from the admin panel, and optional Google reCAPTCHA validation keeps fraudulent and spam submissions out.

Free Features

  • Clean & Simple Builder: Easily create forms by clicking some buttons – no coding skills required.
  • Responsive Design: Forms are fully responsive, ensuring a seamless experience on various devices.
  • Submitted Data Review: See visitor-submitted data at a glance in the admin panel.
  • reCAPTCHA: Controllable Google reCAPTCHA validation to prevent fraud submissions.
  • Security: OVOForm prioritizes the security of your data, implementing measures to protect against spam and malicious submissions.

How to Use

  1. Install and activate the OVOForm plugin.
  2. Open the OVOForm dashboard and create a new form with the form builder.
  3. Add your input fields and save the form.
  4. Copy the form’s shortcode and paste it into any page or post.
  5. Review visitor submissions from the admin panel.

Use Cases

  • Contact Forms: Let visitors reach you from any page.
  • Surveys: Collect structured answers from your audience.
  • Data Collection: Gather and review visitor submissions in one place.

Privacy Notice

We’ve used google reCaptch plugin from google. You’ve to share the api key and api secret key to the plugin in order to use google reCaptch on the form.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “OVOForm”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Open the OVOForm dashboard to create your first form.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Create a form and place its shortcode in any page or post.
sections.faq:
Do I need coding skills to build a form?

No. OVOForm’s clean, simple builder lets you create forms by clicking buttons – no coding required.

How do I display a form on a page?

Create the form in the OVOForm dashboard, then paste its shortcode into any page or post. The form renders automatically on the front end.

Where can I see form submissions?

Visitor-submitted data is stored and shown in the plugin’s admin panel, so you can review every submission from your WordPress dashboard.

How does OVOForm prevent spam submissions?

You can enable Google reCAPTCHA validation on your forms. Enter your reCAPTCHA API key and secret key in the plugin’s configuration to activate it.

Are the forms mobile-friendly?

Yes. Forms created with OVOForm are fully responsive and work seamlessly across devices.
